scope: Claude Code ignores CLAUDE_CODE_EVEN_MORE_DANGEROUSLY_SKIP_PERMISSIONS while any PermissionRequest hook is configured. A local launch that sets an accepted waiver value omits only that hook, and the permission_prompt notification remains observable with the tool name from the preceding PreToolUse event.

observed_hook_sequence: Notification with notification_type=permission_prompt and a generic message
claude_code.notification_payload_note: The observed Notification has no tool_name; lapis derives the notice tool name from the immediately preceding PreToolUse event for the same prompt.

runs.case: waiver, repaired lapis_session_service --claude, installed Claude Code

checks.name: focused clang-tidy on changed C++ files
installed Claude Code through real session service
checks.command: CLAUDE_CODE_EVEN_MORE_DANGEROUSLY_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import check_claude_hooks as check; check.SUPPORTED_VERSION = "2.1.309"; raise SystemExit(check.main(["--fake-model", "--build-dir", "build/desktop", "--output", "build/claude-hooks-waiver-repro/final-live-integrated.json"]))'
checks.note: The in-memory override only accepts the installed 2.1.309 version; the service, hooks and Claude Code binary are unmodified.

superseded_historical_observation.reuse: Not reused for current accepted-value or tool-name claims because its original launcher did not record each waiver value or the repaired service digest.

limitations: This receipt covers hook selection, Bash permission attention and focused adapter sanitizers; it does not rerun every desktop CTest or the full CLI/UI harness.
A full just desktop run at the pinned baseline failed in unrelated pre-existing static-analysis findings under apps/desktop; focused build and claude-observer CTest passed.
A PermissionRequest hook configured outside lapis (user settings, plugin or policy) still suppresses the waiver locally.
lapis treats 1, true, yes and on (any case, surrounding whitespace ignored) as set; another value keeps the hook, which keeps Claude Code's prompt.
The live tool-name correlation is qualified for Claude Code 2.1.309 Bash prompts; a future Claude payload change requires requalification.
Not exercised in the desktop app with a native window.
